card.summary: H.R. 10184, the Consumer Financial Protection Accountability and Reform Act of 2026, makes structural and procedural changes to the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection. The bill alters how the Bureau is funded, revises supervisory thresholds, modifies requirements for issuing rules and conducting cost-benefit analyses, places new limits on enforcement actions, establishes safe harbors and legal frameworks for specific credit and earned wage access products, and sets new standards for consumer complaint processing and interagency coordination.
card.title: Consumer Financial Protection Accountability and Reform Act of 2026
